scope: Cells were lysed in ice-chilled DOC lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-Cl pH 7.5, 1% sodiumdeoxycholate (SDC), 1 mM EDTA-Na, +1× complete) using a Precellys homogenizer (Bertin Technologies).
Soluble proteins in the supernatant fraction were digested using a modified FASP procedure.
Insoluble proteins were collected by centrifugation, solubilized in 6 M guanidinium hydrochloride, 100 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, and reduced, alkylated, precipitated, and digested as described before.
